description: Bundled fallback and deterministic-replay snapshot of BC Wildfire Service active fires and fire perimeters: 105 fire points and 73 perimeter polygons. Used when ?data=snapshot is set, and as the last-resort fallback when both the server-side mirror and the live feeds are unreachable.
publisher: Province of British Columbia, BC Wildfire Service (Ministry of Forests)
licence: Open Government Licence - British Columbia, version 2.0
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - British Columbia.
notes: generator is null because no script in pipeline/ produces this file; it was assembled by hand from the two query URLs above, which are the same URLs pipeline/live.py issues. Perimeter geometry is generalised server-side by maxAllowableOffset=0.002 (about 150 m at this latitude), a request parameter rather than a local edit; otherwise the upstream GeoJSON is unmodified apart from being placed under the 'fires' and 'perimeters' keys. The Information was modified. The Province of British Columbia does not endorse this project and nothing here has official status. This file is a pinned input for tests/golden/: regenerating it changes every golden output.
